mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is below 225.0, the economy is in a sustainable expansion phase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 470.0 and CPIAUCSL < 225.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising (e.g., FEDFUNDS > 0.1% in the last month), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 450.0 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 450.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is strong and retail sales (RSAFS) are rising, the economy is experiencing robust consumer spending and job creation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000.0 and RSAFS > 380000.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to adopt accommodative policies, stimulating economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
